title: Chapter 745
text:
After locking onto the location of Orozen and the others, Han Xiao immediately contacted Hella and Fu Ding.

"Where are you?"

The screen showed the scene of a beast fighting casino. A few strange beasts from different planets were fighting each other. The edge of the arena was separated from the audience by a protective shield, and the audience was filled with people. Countless people were cheering for the beasts that they had placed their bets on, and the atmosphere was feverish. Fu Ding sat in the crowded audience, while Hella and Aurora sat beside him, watching the arena attentively.

Fu Ding helplessly replied, "This is the largest public casino in the main city. We're gambling here."

"Since when did you like gambling?" Han Xiao was surprised.

"Cough, I don't like it. It's Chen Xing who insisted that I come here to gamble. She said why would I not want the money that was guaranteed? She asked me to come here to support the family …"

Han Xiao's mouth twitched. "Then what about the two of them?"

"They insisted on coming with me …"

As soon as he said that, the battle in the arena came to an end. A giant python with green scales and a head that was dozens of meters long spewed out a poisonous mist, paralyzing the last giant beast and standing at the end.

"We won again! We won again!" Aurora waved her arms excitedly. "Sister, we've already won four times in a row!"

Hella nodded slowly and turned to look at Fu Ding, seemingly addicted. "Who are you betting on next?"

Fu Ding shrugged with a helpless expression that said, "It's not that I want to lead them astray."

Han Xiao felt a toothache when he saw this. He coughed and said seriously, "Stop playing. We have things to do. Come and meet up with me now. I'll wait for you at Citadel No. 2. I'll send you the location later."

With that, Han Xiao turned off the communication. While maintaining his brain connection to the floating city's control center, he left the port and headed straight for Citadel No. 2.

There was no time like the present. Han Xiao planned to make a move against Orozen and the others tonight!

After all, Sardeem was a subordinate of the Mecha Empire, and this matter was a little sensitive, so Han Xiao still did not intend to reveal his true identity. Since he had already obtained the blueprint, there was no need to continue staying on Planet Macipher. Barne's fake identity was no longer useful, so he was not afraid of using the name 'Barne' to cause trouble here. He could directly deal with Orozen and the others on the planet's surface without worrying about the consequences.

Han Xiao waited for a while at the rendezvous point in Citadel No. 2. Hella and the other two quickly joined him. As soon as they met, Aurora noticed the change in Han Xiao and screamed.

"Your life force has become stronger again!"

Fu Ding and Hella were stunned when they heard this.

Han Xiao did not deny it and nodded. "I have a feeling that I've already touched the threshold of the Beyond Grade A realm."

Hella's body trembled, and she stared deeply at Han Xiao with a complicated expression.

Fu Ding was sincerely happy for Han Xiao and asked, "So, are we leaving Planet Macipher?"

"Hmm, but before we leave, there's one more thing we need to do …"

Han Xiao then explained his intention to kill Orozen.

Hella nodded. "The enemy has a Grade A Super. Fu Ding and I will go with you. Aurora, go back to the spaceship and wait."

Fu Ding did not have any objections to chasing after wanted criminals, but he was a little confused. "With your strength, you don't need our help to deal with one or two Calamity Grade Supers, right?"

Han Xiao shook his head, and his tone became serious. "Don't underestimate this group of people. They might be EsGod's subordinates, EsGod's doppelgängers with Beyond Grade A strength. We have to deal fatal damage to them the moment the battle starts, so we have to go all out from the start. Only with you guys will we have a higher chance of success!"

Hearing that the enemy was related to Beyond Grade As, Fu Ding and Hella's expressions also became serious.

"If the enemy summons EsGod's doppelgängers, with my strength, I won't be in any danger, but you guys are different. Therefore, you have to listen to my orders. We only have one chance."

Han Xiao immediately explained the battle plan to everyone.

He had already suffered once, so he did not rush over. He did not dare to be careless in front of a Beyond Grade A Super because he had the advantage of being in the dark. He decided to make full preparations first.

…

Citadel No. 2, 'Star Bridge' Hotel. This was where Colin and the others were staying.

The 'Star Bridge' Hotel was located in the red light district of Citadel No. 2. This district was filled with countless entertainment facilities, and the flow of people was huge. This hotel was expensive, and it stood in the middle of a street, extremely eye-catching.

Colin and the others arrived on Planet Macipher that day. After sending their spaceships for maintenance, they stayed in the hotel and spent money like water. They called for a large number of call girls of different races to party to their heart's content, working from day to night.

The members of the Fallen Ark naturally did not have much integrity and were used to indulging their desires. Even if Colin had a mission in mind, he did not reject this activity. This was because once they crossed the Star Field, they would spend a few years in the desolate universe belt. The last one or two days on Planet Macipher would be their last chance to enjoy themselves.

Colin pushed away the girl sleeping on top of him, climbed up from the bed, and glanced around. There were more than ten exhausted female creatures lying on the spacious bed.

He put on a casual robe to cover the scars all over his body, took out a bottle of blue stimulant synthetic alcohol from the fridge, drank half of it in one gulp, and walked to the single-sided window in the hotel room, looking at the scenery outside.

It was already late at night, but there were still many people on the streets. Four to five out of ten people were drunk. The sky above the city was filled with red and green neon lights, making this planet look like a luxurious place. From time to time, hovering vehicles would fly across the sky, and mechanical security forces would patrol nearby.

Looking at the scenery outside, Colin recalled his actions in the past few months. He had secretly done two big things in the Shattered Star Ring, almost turning the Star Pupil Protoss upside down. Even the local Beyond Grade As were fooled by them. Now that he was about to retire, Colin could not help but feel a sense of pride.

Touching the Evolution Cube on his neck, Colin could not help but smirk.

"Ah … Shattered Star Ring."

This Star Field is just so-so.

The moment this thought appeared in his mind, the single-sided window in front of him was suddenly covered by a dazzling light.

Boom!

The next moment, the window exploded!

The powerful shockwave directly sent Colin, who was standing in front of the window, flying. He crashed through the wall of the room and landed in the hallway of the inn. At the same time, the same explosion occurred in all the rooms. One by one, Colin's subordinates were blown away and fell to the ground like him.

The entire hotel seemed to have been bombed. Bricks and stones flew everywhere, and dust splashed everywhere, turning the place into a mess.

Orozen, who was completely naked, also landed in the corridor. Colin immediately exchanged glances with him, and their gloomy and angry eyes revealed the same message.

Someone attacked them?

Could it be the bounty hunters?

The enemy could only be here for the Tyla Civilization's bounty. With two Calamity Grade Supers here, these bounty hunters were simply courting death!

Colin glared at Orozen fiercely and was about to erupt with his Calamity Grade strength to get rid of these bounty hunters.

The next moment, two mental shockwaves swept past like hurricanes. One was dark red, and the other was colorless, sweeping through the entire hotel.

Hu!

The brains of all his subordinates suddenly exploded, turning into blood and flesh. Only Colin and Orozen managed to withstand the two mental shockwaves. However, their brains were also in extreme pain, and their minds went blank. They temporarily lost control of their bodies.

There were two Calamity Grade Supers among the bounty hunters?

Colin and Orozen's expressions changed drastically.

However, before they could struggle, a strong light flashed before their eyes again.

This was the last scene they saw.

…

Outside the Star Bridge Hotel, the pedestrians on the street were all shocked and ran far away.

Just a moment ago, a black mechanical army that blotted out the sky had suddenly appeared, surrounding the Star Bridge Hotel in three layers inside and three layers outside. They were firing madly at the hotel, with each round containing tens of thousands of light cannons.

Boom!

Half of the street where the Star Bridge Hotel was located was directly razed to the ground!

The people on the street were blocked by the Mech Legion, and they could not see through the dense Mech Legion to see what was happening inside.

On the other side, within the encirclement of the Mech Legion, Han Xiao looked at the two corpses in front of him with a strange expression.

These two corpses belonged to Colin and Orozen.

Before the two of them could even resist, they were instantly killed by the Mech Legion's ambush and died on the spot!

Han Xiao had tried his best to overestimate the strength of his opponents. Originally, he was prepared to personally charge in and fight when the Mech Legion ambushed them. However, he did not expect to be able to kill these two Calamity Grade Supers in one round of ambush.

This was much smoother than he had expected.

Han Xiao originally had a few backup plans, but he realized that they were all useless. Instead, he was shocked to see how easy it was.

Aren't these people EsGod's subordinates? Why are they so weak?

He had thought that EsGod's subordinates would be stronger, but it felt no different from killing other Calamity Grade Supers …

Han Xiao's mouth twitched, and he felt as though he had punched cotton.

It was like using a sledgehammer to kill a chicken. It was as though he was fighting with the air.

Hmm, it might be because I just completed my Class Advancement and my strength increased, so I can crush normal Calamity Grade Supers even more easily … By the way, these two don't have any talents that are immune to True Damage, so it's not surprising that they were instantly killed by my three attacks of True Damage.

Han Xiao could only convince himself like this.

He originally had the strength to crush Calamity Grade Supers, and he had just completed his Class Advancement. Not to mention two, even twenty Calamity Grade Supers would not be a problem.

With Orozen dead, [Harrofal's Revenge] was displayed as complete. Han Xiao got Philip to use a mechanical suit to carry Orozen's corpse and bring it back to the Tyla Civilization to exchange for the bounty.

This time, he looked at the corpse of the other Calamity Grade Super, Colin, and noticed the square accessory on Colin's neck.

What's this thing? It actually didn't get destroyed after being ambushed by the army?

Han Xiao was a little curious, so he bent down and picked up the small black square.

The moment his finger touched the small black square, an item introduction popped up on the interface.

With just one look, Han Xiao's face froze. He rubbed his eyes, looked at the item introduction again, and almost could not believe his eyes.

Evolution … Cube?

Is there something wrong with my eyes?!

Isn't this Sisko's Universal Treasure? Why is it here?

Did I just pick up a divine weapon on the street?

Han Xiao grabbed the Evolution Cube and was dumbfounded.

All of a sudden, he understood.

He turned around and stared at Fu Ding.

"Why are you looking at me?"

Fu Ding's hair stood on end from Han Xiao's invasive gaze.

Han Xiao swallowed his saliva, raised his thumb, and almost broke his voice.

"Fu Ding — awesome!"

Fu Ding's face was filled with question marks.

…

A few minutes later, Sardeem arrived at Acropolis No. 2 with a large mechanical army and arrived at the scene.

At this time, the Star Bridge Hotel was only a pile of ruins. Countless people were gathered around, pointing and discussing. Meanwhile, Han Xiao's group and the Mech Legion had disappeared without a trace.

The security forces hurriedly cleaned up the scene but did not find any clues.

"The people I was monitoring are all dead, and their corpses are gone. I can't even find the traces of the attackers?"

Sardeem was furious.

Because of Han Xiao's control, the spies that Sardeem used to monitor Colin and the others did not inform him immediately. The mechanical security forces also did not stop Han Xiao's group along the way. Even the surveillance images were destroyed, making it impossible for Sardeem to track them.

Sardeem was still in the dark and had no idea what was going on.

Who killed Colin and the others?

To be able to kill a Calamity Grade Super in such a short time, how strong was the attacker?

Furthermore, what was the attacker's motive? Were they bounty hunters? Or were they a special force that took orders from Sisko? Or was there more to it?

If the attacker was not Sisko's men, how was he going to explain to Sisko when the people he was monitoring were all killed and the attacker disappeared?

Sardeem could not help but have a headache. He could only report this sudden situation to Sisko.
